source: Own measurement, NATIVE and OUTSIDE THE ENGINE: it has to be measured again through `ale validate` before the task is merged. The privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) was run through this folder's verify stage (tests/verify.py as an ordinary account, the kit's Solver and probe lock, one fresh cell process per pack) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs) in the author's Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 / Isaac Lab 3.0.0 environment on the author's server (RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570, PhysX on the CPU, one GPU of the server only). THE VALUE IS THE MEASUREMENT ON THE TREE OF 9cc3b1c, the cell as it is now (a sensor's depth, each cell's own camera mounting, sealant over heads, a pack's look): mean_pack_credit 1.00000, every pack 1.0 (49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed) in 921, 852, 1040, 1066, 1151 and 1185 steps, the steps of every tree since 21ac344; no protective stop; the probe lock 83 of 83 (53 idle pairs not counted); the stage 2031 s. 846a4f49 changed only two READMEs, and an independent review re-ran the reference on it with the same result step for step (stage 1468 s). f2703af6 (the grader's deadline, a process cap, the cell-failure rule, the image's OpenBLAS pins for the graded cell as root; the cell and the reference unchanged): mean_pack_credit 1.00000 again, every pack 1.0 in the same steps, no protective stop, no cell retry, the probe lock 83 of 83 (53 idle), the controller's own time 7.1 s, the stage 1429 s. Earlier trees, in tests/README.md, section 6: 1.00000 on 230187b, 21ac344 (twice), 152fdf7 and 8439170; 0.99440 on 15d8694, whose cell threw ejected fasteners out of their bins (fixed in 8439170 by a cap of 0.3 m/s on how fast the physics pushes a fastener's body out of an overlap). No Docker on that server: the image was never built, the cell never ran as its own account, and no engine gate has run.
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step; the one spread measured is that of a small perturbation of its trajectory (the conversion change of 15d8694), which, with the cell's defect of then (fasteners thrown out of their bins, fixed in 8439170), moved mean_pack_credit from 1.00000 to 0.99440 (one pack by 2.7 %), and 0.95 leaves about nine times that. It leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that ends outside a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). It has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts.
